name: Turbos Finance
description: Concentrated-liquidity (Uniswap-v3-style CLMM) DEX on Sui. Agents can quote and execute swaps, open/adjust/close LP positions (NFTs), and collect fees and rewards through Move calls or the official TypeScript SDK (turbos-clmm-sdk).

keyFunctions.signature: swap_router::swap_a_b<CoinTypeA,CoinTypeB,FeeType>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, coins_a: vector<Coin<A>>, amount: u64, amount_threshold: u64, sqrt_price_limit: u128, is_exact_in: bool, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Swap coin A -> coin B in one pool. is_exact_in=true: amount = exact A in, amount_threshold = min B out; false: amount = exact B out, amount_threshold = max A in. sqrt_price_limit: use MIN_SQRT_PRICE 4295048016 for no limit. Output and leftover A are sent to recipient. Type args <CoinTypeA, CoinTypeB, FeeType> must equal the pool object's type (read it from the pool, e.g. Pool<SUI, USDC, 0x91bf…::fee3000bps::FEE3000BPS>). clock = 0x6, versioned = Versioned object 0xf1cf…5b6f. deadline is a unix timestamp in milliseconds.

keyFunctions.signature: swap_router::swap_b_a<CoinTypeA,CoinTypeB,FeeType>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, coins_b: vector<Coin<B>>, amount: u64, amount_threshold: u64, sqrt_price_limit: u128, is_exact_in: bool, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Swap coin B -> coin A. Same semantics as swap_a_b; no-limit sqrt_price_limit is MAX_SQRT_PRICE 79226673515401279992447579055.
Public (PTB-composable) version of swap_a_b: returns (output coin B, leftover coin A) instead of transferring. The Turbos SDK uses the *_with_return_ functions.
Public version of swap_b_a returning (output coin A, leftover coin B).

keyFunctions.signature: swap_router::swap_a_b_b_c<CoinTypeA,FeeTypeA,CoinTypeB,FeeTypeB,CoinTypeC>(pool_a: &mut Pool<A,B,FeeA>, pool_b: &mut Pool<B,C,FeeB>, coins_a: vector<Coin<A>>, amount: u64, amount_threshold: u64, sqrt_price_limit_a: u128, sqrt_price_limit_b: u128, is_exact_in: bool, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock, versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Two-hop swap A -> B -> C. Note the type-arg order (A, FeeA, B, FeeB, C). Variants swap_a_b_c_b, swap_b_a_b_c, swap_b_a_c_b cover the other pool orientations; each has a *_with_return_ form.

keyFunctions.signature: pool_fetcher::compute_swap_result<A,B,Fee>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, a_to_b: bool, amount_specified: u128, amount_specified_is_input: bool, sqrt_price_limit: u128, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx) -> ComputeSwapState
keyFunctions.description: Quote a swap without executing it; call it through devInspect/dry-run (the SDK reads amount_a, amount_b, fee_amount, sqrt_price, tick_current_index from the result). The SDK's trade.computeSwapResultV2 wraps this.

keyFunctions.signature: position_manager::mint<A,B,Fee>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, positions: &mut Positions, coins_a: vector<Coin<A>>, coins_b: vector<Coin<B>>, tick_lower_index: u32, tick_lower_index_is_neg: bool, tick_upper_index: u32, tick_upper_index_is_neg: bool, amount_a_desired: u64, amount_b_desired: u64, amount_a_min: u64, amount_b_min: u64, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Open a concentrated-liquidity position; mints a TurbosPositionNFT to recipient. Ticks are passed as absolute value + is_neg flag and must be multiples of the pool tick spacing. Unused coins are returned. Positions = 0xf576…e52d. mint_with_return_ returns (NFT, Coin<A>, Coin<B>).

keyFunctions.signature: position_manager::increase_liquidity<A,B,Fee>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, positions: &mut Positions, coins_a: vector<Coin<A>>, coins_b: vector<Coin<B>>, nft: &mut TurbosPositionNFT, amount_a_desired: u64, amount_b_desired: u64, amount_a_min: u64, amount_b_min: u64, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Add liquidity to an existing position (nft comes after the coin vectors on-chain; the docs page lists a different order).

keyFunctions.signature: position_manager::decrease_liquidity<A,B,Fee>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, positions: &mut Positions, nft: &mut TurbosPositionNFT, liquidity: u128, amount_a_min: u64, amount_b_min: u64, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Remove `liquidity` units from a position. On-chain there is no recipient argument (the docs page shows one). decrease_liquidity_with_return_ returns (Coin<A>, Coin<B>).

keyFunctions.signature: position_manager::collect<A,B,Fee>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, positions: &mut Positions, nft: &mut TurbosPositionNFT, amount_a_max: u64, amount_b_max: u64, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Collect trading fees owed to the position (use u64::MAX for all).

keyFunctions.signature: position_manager::collect_reward<A,B,Fee,RewardCoin>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, positions: &mut Positions, nft: &mut TurbosPositionNFT, vault: &mut PoolRewardVault<RewardCoin>, reward_index: u64, amount_max: u64, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Claim liquidity-mining rewards for reward_index; the reward vault id is in the pool's reward_infos.
Entry. Burn an empty position NFT (decrease all liquidity and collect fees/rewards first).
Tick lower, tick upper and liquidity of a position NFT.

keyFunctions.signature: pool_factory::deploy_pool_and_mint<A,B,Fee>(pool_config: &mut PoolConfig, fee_type: &Fee<FeeType>, sqrt_price: u128, positions: &mut Positions, coins_a, coins_b, tick_lower_index: u32, tick_lower_index_is_neg: bool, tick_upper_index: u32, tick_upper_index_is_neg: bool, amount_a_desired: u64, amount_b_desired: u64, amount_a_min: u64, amount_b_min: u64, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock, versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Create a new pool for a pair/fee tier and add initial liquidity. fee_type is the Fee object of the tier (ids in contract.json "fee"). deploy_pool(...) creates a pool without liquidity.
Find the pool id for a pair and fee type (via devInspect). Off-chain, the SDK pool.getPools() reads the PoolConfig pools table.

contracts.name: Turbos CLMM package (original id, used in type names)
Versioned (shared object, passed to every call)

offchainApis.name: turbos-clmm-sdk (npm)
offchainApis.use: Official TypeScript SDK: sdk.pool.getPools/getPool, sdk.trade.computeSwapResultV2 (quote) and sdk.trade.swap (builds the swap Transaction), sdk.pool.addLiquidity/increaseLiquidity/decreaseLiquidity/removeLiquidity, collectFee/collectReward, vault helpers. Init: new TurbosSdk(Network.mainnet).

offchainApis.name: Turbos contract config
offchainApis.use: Official JSON of current package ids, shared objects and fee-tier Fee object ids for mainnet/testnet; the SDK reads it (sdk.contract.getConfig()). Re-read it after upgrades instead of hard-coding the published-at id.

offchainApis.name: Turbos Move interface
offchainApis.use: Move stubs for calling Turbos CLMM from your own package (tag mainnet-v0.1.8).

actions.name: swap
actions.how: SDK: q = sdk.trade.computeSwapResultV2({pools:[{pool, a2b, amountSpecified}], address, amountSpecifiedIsInput:true}); tx = sdk.trade.swap({routes:[{pool, a2b, nextTickIndex: sdk.math.bitsToNumber(q[0].tick_current_index.bits)}], coinTypeA, coinTypeB, address, amountA, amountB: q[0].amount_b, amountSpecifiedIsInput:true, slippage:"0.5"}); sign and execute. Direct: moveCall <published-at>::swap_router::swap_a_b (or swap_b_a) with the pool type args.

actions.name: add liquidity
actions.how: position_manager::mint with pool, Positions 0xf576…e52d, coin vectors, tick range (abs + is_neg), desired/min amounts, recipient, deadline (ms), clock 0x6, Versioned 0xf1cf…5b6f; or sdk.pool.addLiquidity.

actions.name: remove liquidity
actions.how: position_manager::decrease_liquidity then collect (and collect_reward per reward index); burn the NFT when empty. SDK: removeLiquidity / decreaseLiquidity.

actions.name: find a pool
actions.description: Locate the pool object for a pair/fee tier.
actions.how: sdk.pool.getPools() or read the PoolConfig (0xc294…170c) pools table; pool type is Pool<CoinA, CoinB, FeeType>.

risks: Upgradeable Move package: the CLMM package has been upgraded many times (on-chain version 22 at research time). Always call the latest published-at id (from contract.json) and pass the Versioned object; old package ids revert on version checks.

Admin powers held via PoolFactoryAdminCap / AclConfig roles: pause/unpause pools (toggle_pool_status), set protocol fee share, add fee tiers, manage rewards, migrate positions, admin decrease_liquidity (decrease_liquidity_admin) and package upgrade.

After the May 2025 Cetus exploit (overflow bug in a shared math library), Verichains reported that the same flawed function existed in the Turbos codebase but was not used; Turbos stated it was not affected.
Concentrated liquidity: positions out of range earn no fees and suffer impermanent loss; set amount_min / slippage and deadlines.

The gitbook Contract Modules page lists some argument orders that differ from the deployed package (increase_liquidity, decrease_liquidity, collect, burn); the signatures here follow the on-chain package and the official Move interface.
notes: Sui is not one of the registry VM types, so vm = "mixed"; the VM is the Sui Move VM and chainId is null. Ids are Sui object/package ids. Mainnet ids come from the official Dev Overview table and the official contract.json (both agree); all were checked on Sui mainnet via GraphQL on 2026-11-25 (PoolConfig, Positions, Versioned are shared objects of the expected 0x91bf… types; the package exposes the listed functions with the listed parameters). Fee-tier Fee objects (needed only to create pools): 10bps 0x49dcf28ac3b5480e65bee812ad2d6e60108ab8037d5a815c3c11bbe7bc47c270, 500bps 0xdfcd1043f54fef3aa649eccd4d0b2b09a3da6c87a8a62736467b686268869365, 3000bps 0x6bc433c8604f58272155d0c65327ae0b316f63869e5de3846f70aef4625d8c46, 10000bps 0xd30c41ec4b4d0eb9b30b0b898c53f81cd53a9eb0f75b5d3273584cd874b2d4c4; full list (100, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 7500, 20000, 40000 bps) in contract.json. The SDK getConfig doc example shows an older PackageId (0x2476…16c8); use contract.json. Vault objects (VaultGlobalConfig 0x2994c75a2ab419adfe16e143bf45ad44c3a5ccfc07c8fe8e31f7c883c8d84c2b, VaultRewarderManager, VaultUserTierConfig) are in contract.json; vault Move functions are not documented beyond the SDK, so no keyFunctions are given (use the SDK vault methods). Not included: Turbos Fun (bonding-curve launchpad, parrot_fun::buy/sell) because its package and config ids are not on an official page; Turbos OMM page is empty; TURBOS on BNB Chain (0xA1E6410bF311C03429B37A76a80C8A5E61616e7F per the token page) is out of scope of the Sui DEX entry. Individual pool ids are not listed: discover them from PoolConfig or the SDK.
